identification: Cyclopedia of Tasmania (Illustrated), Vols I and II, Maitland and Krone, Hobart 1900 (Niven, Melbourne and Ballarat). Photos show the Vol I title page (royal arms), Vol II title page dated 1900, Parliament, Launceston and Hobart plates, portrait pages; paper foxed and period-looking, so it reads as the original, not the modern facsimile. Half leather, worn. Read: title pages, Tasmania introduction, headings. Not readable: any binder or reprint note, index, last pages.
